subject: inorganic
question:
无机化学·配位化学：请判断下列配合物的几何构型：Tetrachloroplatinate（[PtCl₄]²⁻）？
A. Square planar
B. Tetrahedral
C. Square pyramidal
D. Trigonal prismatic
explanation: Square planar. Covalent count: Pt (group 10) 10 e; 4 × Cl (X) 4 e; the 2− charge adds 2 e: 16 e. Ionic count: the ligands carry a charge of −4 in all and the complex has a 2− charge, so the metal is Pt(II), d⁸; d⁸ + 8 e from the ligands = 16 e.
